- **Subtitles synced to the audio when AutoSync can't.** When a stream has no embedded subtitles, or AutoSync's match is too weak and it keeps the original timing, the subtitle is now aligned with the dialogue by listening to the audio. It follows frame-rate differences and scenes a release adds or cuts, and can switch to another subtitle in the same language that fits better. A small panel in the top-left corner shows its progress.
- **Speech model for faster, more precise sync.** Turning on AutoSync offers a one-time download of a speech recognition model, which lets the audio sync recognise English dialogue. It can also be downloaded or deleted later.
- **New settings** under Nuvio Reshaped › Subtitle AutoSync: "Sync to audio when AutoSync can't" (on by default), the speech model, sampling across the film on mobile data (off by default), and "Share audio sync log" for reporting problems.
